subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should OpenClaw merge this downstream stuck-recovery classification as the generic safety boundary after the provider-owned opencode-go stream fix?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes how active session aborts are classified for failover and replay safety, so owner intent is needed before accepting the session-state and availability tradeoff.

options.title: Approve the downstream boundary
options.body: Merge this PR after owner review because it preserves provider fixes while making stuck-recovery failover safer for model stalls and side-effecting tool stalls.

options.title: Ask for live outage proof first
options.body: Hold the PR until a maintainer or contributor can reproduce the original cron/provider outage against a live setup and show the combined provider plus recovery behavior.

options.title: Close as provider-fix-only
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the merged opencode-go provider boundary is the only supported fix and downstream recovery should remain external-abort-like.

recommendation.title: Approve the downstream boundary
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after owner review because it preserves provider fixes while making stuck-recovery failover safer for model stalls and side-effecting tool stalls.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and already defined the model-call versus side-effecting-tool classification requirement.
